✅ Good news: you need NO key at all!
Aurisi works 100% free — fill nothing and you are done. Keys below are optional power-ups for faster replies and live web search.
1️⃣ Best free key — Gemini (recommended)
How to get it (2 minutes, free):
1. Open aistudio.google.com and sign in with Google
2. Tap Get API key → Create API key
3. Copy it and paste here, then press Save
What it gives: fastest smart replies + Google web search + AI voices.
2️⃣ Speed power-up — Groq
How to get it (free):
1. Open console.groq.com and sign up
2. Go to API Keys → Create API Key
3. Paste it here and press Save
What it gives: lightning-fast replies (Llama AI).
3️⃣ Live web search — Tavily
How to get it (free, 1000 searches/month):
1. Open app.tavily.com and sign up
2. Copy your API key
3. Paste it here, press Save, then turn ON 🔎 Web search on replies in the General tab
What it gives: fresh current-affairs answers with sources.
4️⃣ Paid keys (only if you already have them)
Paid — platform.openai.com. Aurisi uses whichever key it finds first.
Paid — console.anthropic.com. Claude Sonnet does the teaching.
Free account switch
Puter is the free backup brain Aurisi uses when no key is set. No setup needed.
